name: miss-leg-b-only-at-the-registered-margin
why: THE SENSITIVITY OBLIGATION, made observable. Leg B's point is 1.25 — over the registered 1.20 margin, under the pooled 1.30 and under w5-parity-002's 1.35 — with the bound firing. The verdict is read at 1.20 AND ONLY AT 1.20, so this is a MISS; the ledger must publish the point and the bound at all three candidates so a leg-B pass that survives only at the most lenient one is visible on the face of the instrument rather than inferable from a paragraph.
